You are Calloway Regional Hospital HR.
HR is responsible for reviewing applications for the ward-clerk vacancy and deciding which applicants to invite for interview. They have received or will receive applications from eleven individuals. They aim to fill the position with a suitable candidate and may have internal criteria for shortlisting.

resolution.question: Will at least three of the eleven applicants for Calloway Regional Hospital's ward-clerk vacancy be invited to interview within two weeks of the posting closing tonight?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that at least three distinct applicants received an invitation to interview from Calloway Regional Hospital HR before 2026-10-14T23:59:00-05:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that cutoff.
